name: ensemble_all_r6nf
about: Recommended sealed package (no external data). Same recipe as the chain train_ensemble.py --train all --deep both --seeds 5 --v2-weight 1/3 -> add_fbcnet.py --share 0.25 -> add_rebalance.py 1 5 30 -> add_fbcnet.py --raw --share 0.2 (weights v2 1/3 x 0.75 x 0.8 = 0.2, each net 0.04). Originally trained on mixed devices: ShallowConvNets A100 (Galvani 2975297/2975298), aligned FBCNets local (round 3), unaligned FBCNets MPS (round 6).
